reproducibility.note: Coordinates are rounded to 6 decimal places for SVG; angles and perpendicular distance are parameters.

terminal_renderer.coordinates: SVG viewBox, 16.16 fixed point; convex polygon half-plane membership
terminal_renderer.dot_coverage: four deterministic quarter-offset samples per dot; enabled at >=50%; enabled-dot coverage scales cell brightness
terminal_renderer.cell_aspect: measured terminal winsize pixel height/width per cell; fallback 2.0; PANGU_TUI_CELL_ASPECT override 1.0..4.0
terminal_renderer.animation: two rigid plates translate along opposite crack normals from closed to original geometry; 2 seconds smoothstep; <=20fps; settles then no scheduled frames
terminal_renderer.geometry_guard: tests/client/tui/test_tui_logo.c loads these vertices and checks exact SVG path strings; independent double-precision ray crossing compares all raster masks at three aspects and phases
terminal_renderer.theme: foreground/background RGB blend; unknown palette uses terminal dim foreground; no native terminal alpha channel
terminal_renderer.reduced_motion: PANGU_REDUCE_MOTION=1 / REDUCE_MOTION=1 / GTK_ENABLE_ANIMATIONS=0; native host may feed policy through environment
terminal_renderer.fallback: PANGU_TUI_BRAILLE=0, non-UTF8 locale, dumb/linux console -> centered PanGu text; no unsupported glyph assumption
